primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名を直接記す。
primaryWitnesses.text: Behold, Amariah the chief priest is over you in all matters of the LORD; and Zebadiah the son of Ishmael, the ruler of the house of Judah, in all the king’s matters. Also the Levites shall be officers before you. Deal courageously, and may the LORD be with the good.”

excludedOccurrences.reasonJa: 同名が別の系譜・文脈にも見つかるが、この割当対象と同一か本文だけでは確定できない。

wikipediaCheck.identityBasisJa: L696–702 lists distinct Amariahs; L699 describes the chief priest and judge appointed by Jehoshaphat at 2 Chronicles 19:11.
